core_problem_solved: To provide the Groovy dynamic language and all of its official modules in a single 'uber-jar' under its original, legacy Maven coordinate.
key_features: Bundled the Groovy compiler, runtime, and all standard extension modules (for XML, JSON, SQL, etc.) into a single JAR file.
era_and_niche: A convenience artifact for very early versions of the Groovy language, used to simplify dependency setup before the project joined the Apache Software Foundation and adopted modern dependency management practices.
reason_for_obsolescence: This artifact is **doubly obsolete**. First, its coordinate is legacy; the project's modern home is **`org.apache.groovy`**. Second, the 'uber-jar' (`-all`) packaging approach is officially discouraged. The modern, recommended way to use Groovy is to depend on the core modular artifact, **`org.apache.groovy:groovy`**.
